text: Security is a crucial part of web development that every developer should take seriously. First, websites should always use HTTPS to encrypt data between the browser and the server, protecting sensitive information from attackers. Second, strong authentication helps ensure that only authorised users can access protected areas. Third, input validation is essential because it prevents users from submitting harmful data that could damage the system. Developers must also be aware of common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, which can be avoided with careful coding. By following these basic principles, developers can build safer and more trustworthy websites for everyone.
